description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS watchdog driver for Andes Technology's ATCWDt200 hardware, including register definitions, initialization, configuration, and control functions.

methods.name: wdt_counter_cb
methods.description: Callback function for watchdog counter alarm, resets watchdog timer.

methods.name: wdt_atcwdt200_set_max_timeout
methods.description: Sets the maximum timeout for the watchdog.

methods.name: wdt_atcwdt200_setup
methods.description: Configures the watchdog with specified options.

methods.name: wdt_atcwdt200_convtime
methods.description: Converts timeout in ms to hardware counter value and scaler.

methods.name: wdt_atcwdt200_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration into the watchdog.

methods.name: wdt_atcwdt200_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog to prevent timeout.

methods.name: wdt_atcwdt200_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device during system startup.
